OGC API – Tiles with a Mapbox Style

ogc7 vectortiles7 mapbox9 ol-mapbox-style4

Styling vector tiles from an OGC API – Tiles service with ol-mapbox-style.

This example renders vector tiles from an OGC API – Tiles service, the BRT Achtergrondkaart (topographic background map) of the Dutch Kadaster.
The layer is styled with ol-mapbox-style, using the Mapbox style document from the OGC API – Styles endpoint of the same service.
The layer and its ol/source/OGCVectorTile source are created first, then applyStyle() adds the style. The updateSource: false option makes sure the style is only used for styling, and the OGC API – Tiles source of the layer is kept.
Finally the map is created with the styled layer.

main.js 
import {applyStyle} from 'ol-mapbox-style';
import Map from 'ol/Map.js';
import View from 'ol/View.js';
import MVT from 'ol/format/MVT.js';
import VectorTileLayer from 'ol/layer/VectorTile.js';
import {useGeographic} from 'ol/proj.js';
import OGCVectorTile from 'ol/source/OGCVectorTile.js';

useGeographic();

const api = 'https://api.pdok.nl/kadaster/brt-achtergrondkaart/ogc/v1';
const title = 'BRT Achtergrondkaart';

// Create the layer with an OGC API - Tiles source first.
const layer = new VectorTileLayer({
  declutter: true,
  properties: {title: title},
  source: new OGCVectorTile({
    url: api + '/tiles/WebMercatorQuad',
    format: new MVT(),
    attributions: `<a href="${api}">${title}</a> © <a href="https://www.kadaster.nl/">Kadaster</a>`,
  }),
});

// Then style it with a Mapbox style from the OGC API - Styles endpoint
// of the same service. With `updateSource: false`, the style is only
// used for styling, and the OGC API - Tiles source of the layer is kept.
// For a dark map, use '/styles/darkmode__webmercatorquad' instead.
applyStyle(layer, api + '/styles/standaard__webmercatorquad', {
  updateSource: false,
});

// Finally create the map with the styled layer.
const map = new Map({
  target: 'map',
  layers: [layer],
  view: new View({
    center: [5.387201, 52.155172],
    zoom: 7,
  }),
});
index.html 
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>OGC API – Tiles with a Mapbox Style</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/ol/ol.css">
    <style>
      .map {
        width: 100%;
        height: 400px;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="map" class="map"></div>

    <script type="module" src="main.js"></script>
  </body>
</html>
